author: Barb Cira-Regan
text: Gary is always quick to respond when we need plumbing assistance. He is friendly and very experienced in his field.  He provides insight about the problem and ways to avoid it without suggesting unnecessary add ons.  When he is finished with the job, he cleans up and things work smoothly without another problem.  We highly recommend Gary for any plumbing issues!

author: Sharon Mattice
text: Gary is an excellent plumber.  He is prompt, neat, thorough and has always been my "GO-TO" when I am in trouble.  He responds quickly and calls before he comes.  I trust Gary and feel free to recommend him to my friends.

author: Dawn Hoff-Cowdery
text: Gary did a great job installing new bathroom fixtures at my house. He was very knowledgeable and friendly! And he also took the time to handle some other plumbing issues that I thought of when he was there. I highly recommend him for any plumbing needs you might have.

author: Robert Carter
text:
I worked with Gary and was extremely impressed. He was professional, punctual, and easy to communicate with from the start. The work was done efficiently, with strong attention to detail, and everything was handled correctly the first time.

He also left the area clean, which speaks to the level of care he puts into his work. It’s clear he takes pride in what he does.

I highly recommend him if you’re looking for reliable, high-quality plumbing services. I’ll definitely be calling him again.

author: Michele Lucco
text: I was a landlord for 38 years and have worked with many very good contractors, but Gary is in a league of his own.  He checked every box. Gary was prompt, knowledgeable, and very neat.  I even peeked in his truck.  Everything was spotless. Gary will always be the one I call for all my plumbing needs.
